### `xml` matcher

Structural XML equality (both sides minified). Value is XML text. Non-string or unparseable XML never matches. https://docs.hoverfly.io/en/latest/pages/keyconcepts/matching/matchers.html

**Value type:** `string`
**Config:** not supported.
**doMatch:** AND-semantics; re-tests the same input against the next matcher.
